<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="Request Certificate">80d089dcc3766a1087613342b40131f3</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>ValidateCsrAndDevice</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onSubmit() {
    var csrValue = g_form.getValue('csr');
    if (csrValue != "") {
        csrValue = csrValue.trim();

        var beginHeader = "-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----";
        var endFooter = "-----END CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----";

        if (!(csrValue.startsWith(beginHeader) && csrValue.endsWith(endFooter))) {
            alert('CSR must start with -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST----- and end with -----END CERTIFICATE REQUEST----- headers.');
            return false;
        }
    }

    var msg = g_form.getValue('validation_message');
    if (msg == "success") {
        return true;
    }
	else if (msg == "error")
	{
		alert('Please resolve the Bind Address and Port validation error before submitting.');
	}
    return false;
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-15 09:26:13</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>6261e2b4c3ba2e1087613342b40131e6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>33</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ValidateCsrAndDevice</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Sixscape IDcentral" source="x_1784056_sixscape">42bb04c3c3a6a21087613342b40131c0</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Sixscape IDcentral">42bb04c3c3a6a21087613342b40131c0</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_6261e2b4c3ba2e1087613342b40131e6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-15 13:47:25</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>10</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
